item.title: Ortiz's wife urged Guardians pitcher to 'delete the evidence,' texts say
item.description: Guardians pitcher Luis Ortiz's wife told him to "delete the evidence" in texts sent after a game in which he allegedly rigged a pitch.

item.title: Sources: Cubs continue spending spree, add 2-time Japanese MVP Sato for $120M
item.description: The Cubs reached a 6-year, $120 million agreement with Japanese INF/OF Teruaki Sato on Tuesday, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.
item.dc:creator: Jesse Rogers

item.title: Sources: Peralta stays in AL East, gets $125M deal to top Orioles rotation
item.description: Freddy Peralta has agreed to a five-year, $125M deal with the Orioles, who have landed an ace starter after losing Trevor Rogers, sources told ESPN.

item.title: Sources: Japanese right-hander Taira, Blue Jays agree to 5-year, $80M deal
item.description: Right-hander Kaima Taira and the Blue Jays have agreed to a five-year, $80 million deal with an opt-out after the third season, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

item.title: Sources: Reds catcher Stephenson staying on $30 million, 3-year deal
item.description: The Reds are retaining catcher Tyler Stephenson on a three-year agreement worth $30 million, sources told ESPN.

item.title: Sources: White Sox add OF Taylor on 2-year, $17 million deal
item.description: Tyrone Taylor, who had a monster second half last season, fills a hole in the White Sox's outfield.
item.dc:creator: Jesse Rogers

item.title: MLB drops escrow provision in salary cap proposal as talks take holiday hiatus
item.description: MLB dropped its demand for an escrow provision in its salary cap proposal, instead saying that an overage or underpayment would be accounted for in future seasons.

item.title: Sources: Guardians, lefty Bubic agree to one-year, $17.5M deal
item.description: Left-hander Kris Bubic and the Guardians are in agreement on a one-year, $17.5 million contract, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Tuesday.
